messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "patients can start Rybelsus up to 7 days after last injection"
set: ["patients can start Rybelsus up to 7 days after last injection", "7 days", "if you choose a different weekly injection day start new schedule after at least 2 days have passed since last injection", "after five days", "titration should proceed over 7 to 14 days", "throw away unused suspension 30 days after made up", "tablet can start to break apart quickly", "requirement applies after at least 30 days on 7 mg dose", "false-positive result can continue for several days after stopping", "increase dose to 7 mg once daily after 30 days on 3 mg dose", "symptoms can take several days to develop", "remove needle after each injection", "after first use, pen can be stored for 56 days", "kept from 8°C to 30°C (46°F to 86°F) for up to 28 days", "store between 59°F to 86°F (15°C to 30°C) or in refrigerator for up to 56 days after first use", "do not double up to catch up"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
